API ReferenceZscaler Cellular APISim HandlingGet all sims data with filter and pagination
Get all sims data with filter and pagination
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcell/config/api/v1/customers/:id/sims/search

Get all sims data with filter and pagination

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Possible values: >= 0

Page number (0-based)

Default value: 0
size
int32

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 100

Page size (1-100)

Default value: 10
sortBy
string

Field to sort by. Default: iccid. Sortable fields: iccid, imei, imsi, msisdn, status, eid, locationCountry, ipAddress, usage, brandName, marketingName, deviceType, modelName.

Default value: iccid
sortDir
string

ASC or DESC. Default: ASC.

Default value: ASC
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

The body type of the operation request or response.

iccid
SanitizedString50 (string)[]

Possible values: <= 50 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

status
SanitizedString20 (string)

Possible values: <= 20 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

networkStatus
SanitizedString20 (string)

Possible values: <= 20 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

ipAddress
SanitizedString20 (string)[]

Possible values: <= 20 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

locationCountry
SanitizedString50 (string)

Possible values: <= 50 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

tag
SanitizedString50 (string)[]

Possible values: <= 50 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

deviceType
SanitizedString255 (string)

Possible values: <= 255 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

brandName
SanitizedString255 (string)

Possible values: <= 255 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

marketingName
SanitizedString255 (string)

Possible values: <= 255 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

modelName
SanitizedString255 (string)

Possible values: <= 255 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

formFactor
SanitizedString20 (string)

Possible values: <= 20 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s.@]*$

imeiStatus
SimImeiStatusEnum (string)

Possible values: [Locked, Unlocked, InProgress]
